what_this_is: The unrouted cohort after PTF-INDIANAPOLIS-ADDRESS-REVIEW-006. Supersedes the 005 cohort for planning.

scopes.why_two_scopes: the 8 identities admitted by CENSUS-ADMISSION-002 and the 3 by APPLY-RULINGS-005 were never part of the audit-measured 118; conflating the two sets would misprice the routing work
scopes.how_whole_shadow_is_counted: the audit-measured cohort PLUS the identities admitted by CENSUS-ADMISSION-002 and APPLY-RULINGS-005 that carry no route. It is NOT "every shadow row with an empty official_url": ~90 RESOLVED rows keep their URL in the authority package rather than the census, so that scan overcounts badly.
